title: First Day at the Language Club · 写作迁移
instructions: 给英语俱乐部的一位成员写2—4个简单句、至少12词。用I am介绍自己，用You are对收信人说一句话。信息可以自编；检查句首大写和陈述句末句号。
prompt: Write a short message to a member of your English club. Write 2–4 simple sentences and at least 12 words. Introduce yourself with I am, and address the other member with You are. You may invent the details. Start each sentence with a capital letter and end each statement with a period.
originalPrompt: 给英语俱乐部的一位成员写2—4个简单句、至少12词。用I am介绍自己，用You are对收信人说一句话。可以自编信息，句首大写，陈述句末用句号。
